message.content: I wake up at six every morning, have a quick yoghurt for breakfast, and then I cycle to the bakery. It's a short ride, maybe ten minutes. I usually listen to the radio while I'm cycling. I get to work, change into my uniform, and start labeling the bread trays. The voice sometimes comes when I'm wiping down the counter, but it doesn't happen all the time. I try to keep a routine because that seems to help. I don't know why the voice shows up, but I just keep going with my work.
